HydroConquest

Dive · 32mm, 39mm, 41mm, 43mm, 44mm · 300m · automatic · 2007–2026

The HydroConquest is Longines' modern dive watch, blending a robust, tool-watch functionality with the brand's characteristic elegance. Signature design cues include a unidirectional rotating bezel, large luminous numerals and markers for legibility, and a water resistance of 300 meters.

The story

Launched in 2007, the HydroConquest was introduced as a contemporary diver, evolving from the sporty Conquest line that dates back to 1954. The first generation featured aluminum bezel inserts and was powered by reliable ETA-based movements. A significant update occurred in 2018, when the collection was redesigned with more streamlined aesthetics and upgraded with scratch-resistant ceramic bezel inserts. This era also saw the introduction of the exclusive Caliber L888 with a longer power reserve, a move away from the standard ETA 2824-based movements of the earlier models. The collection has continued to evolve with new dial colors, the introduction of a GMT model in 2023, and a comprehensive redesign in 2026 that further refined the case and dial design.
